body: The euro-area central bank's governing council raised the main refinancing rate by 25 basis points, above the unchanged rate most surveyed economists had expected. The accompanying statement said further tightening would depend on services inflation.
headline: Euro-area central bank raises its main refinancing rate by 25 basis points

body: A second wire report of the same governing council decision repeats the 25 basis point increase and the reference to services inflation. No new figure is given.
headline: Rate decision: euro-area central bank moves to 25 basis point increase

body: An earlier report of a 25 basis point increase was wrong. The governing council raised the main refinancing rate by 50 basis points. The earlier figure should be disregarded.
headline: Correction: euro-area rate increase was 50 basis points, not 25

body: The northern reserve board left its policy target unchanged and removed the sentence on further tightening that had appeared in its previous three statements.
headline: Northern reserve board holds its policy rate and drops the tightening bias

body: The statistics office's flash estimate put harmonised consumer price inflation at 2.9 per cent year on year, against 2.6 per cent expected. Core prices rose 3.1 per cent.
headline: Euro-area harmonised consumer prices rise 2.9 per cent year on year

body: The statistics office republished its flash estimate without revision. Harmonised consumer prices rose 2.9 per cent year on year.
headline: Flash inflation estimate confirmed at 2.9 per cent in second release

body: Non-farm payroll employment rose by 310,000, against 175,000 expected. The unemployment rate fell to 3.7 per cent and average hourly earnings rose 0.4 per cent on the month.
headline: Northern economy adds 310,000 jobs, well above expectations

body: The euro-area current account surplus narrowed to 12 billion from 31 billion, driven by a deterioration in the goods balance.
headline: Euro-area current account surplus narrows sharply in April

body: Finance ministers ended two days of talks without agreement on a joint borrowing framework. Two member states withheld consent; no new meeting was scheduled.
headline: Euro-area finance ministers fail to agree a joint borrowing framework

body: The euro-area central bank said the governing council would hold an unscheduled call this afternoon. It gave no agenda.
headline: Euro-area central bank announces an unscheduled governing council call

body: A regional airline said load factors reached 88 per cent, its best quarter on record, and raised its full-year guidance.
headline: Regional airline reports its best quarterly load factor on record

body: Two mid-cap software firms agreed an all-share merger valuing the smaller at a 22 per cent premium. Both boards recommended the deal.
headline: Two mid-cap software firms agree an all-share merger

body: A grocery chain recalled one batch of chilled desserts after a labelling error. No illness was reported.
headline: Grocery chain recalls a batch of chilled desserts

body: The euro traded 0.3 per cent firmer against the dollar in a quiet session with no scheduled releases. Volumes were below the twenty-day average.
headline: Euro strengthens against the dollar in quiet afternoon trade

body: A euro-area listed brewer opened a distribution centre employing 140 people, part of a previously announced capital plan.
headline: Euro-area listed brewer opens a distribution centre

body: A football club refinanced stadium debt at a lower coupon, extending maturities by seven years.
headline: Football club refinances its stadium debt

body: A municipal transport authority raised single-ride fares by 10 cents, its first increase in four years.
headline: Municipal transport authority raises single-ride fares

body: A national weather service issued a two-day heat advisory for the southern coast, with temperatures forecast above 38 degrees.
headline: Weather service issues a heat advisory for the southern coast

body: A regional water utility's dollar-denominated bond issue was fully subscribed. The proceeds refinance maturing debt.
headline: Dollar-denominated bond issue by a regional water utility is fully subscribed

body: A retail chain reported a 1 per cent decline in like-for-like sales and held its guidance unchanged.
headline: Retail chain's like-for-like sales fall 1 per cent in the quarter

body: An official who asked not to be named said the exchange rate was being watched closely. The institution declined to comment.
headline: Unnamed official says the exchange rate is being watched closely

body: A survey of 41 economists found 20 expecting a further increase and 21 expecting no change. The previous survey was not directly comparable.
headline: Survey of economists shows a wide split on the next policy move

body: A document described as a draft growth forecast circulated ahead of its scheduled publication. Its authenticity was not confirmed.
headline: Leaked draft of a growth forecast circulates ahead of publication

body: Trade negotiations between two blocs resumed. Neither side published an agenda or a timetable.
headline: Trade negotiations resume with no agenda published

body: A scheduled appearance by a central bank speaker was cancelled. No reason was given and no text was released.
headline: Central bank speaker cancels a scheduled appearance

body: The quarterly bank lending survey showed credit standards tightening for a fourth consecutive quarter, in line with the previous reading.
headline: Euro-area bank lending survey shows a fourth quarter of tightening standards

body: Industrial production for April was revised to a 0.2 per cent monthly decline from 0.1 per cent.
headline: Euro-area industrial production revised down by 0.1 percentage point

body: The minutes of the May meeting showed two participants favouring an increase. The decision and statement were published in May.
headline: Northern reserve board publishes the minutes of its May meeting

body: In prepared remarks the chair repeated that decisions would be taken meeting by meeting and that the board was not on a preset path.
headline: Northern reserve board chair repeats that decisions will be taken meeting by meeting

body: The euro-area unemployment rate was unchanged at 6.4 per cent, matching expectations and the previous month.
headline: Euro-area unemployment rate unchanged at 6.4 per cent

body: El consejo de gobierno del banco central de la zona euro subio el tipo de referencia en 25 puntos basicos. El comunicado condiciona nuevas subidas a la inflacion de servicios.
headline: El banco central de la zona euro sube su tipo de referencia en 25 puntos basicos

body: Una segunda agencia informa de la misma decision del consejo de gobierno, sin aportar cifras nuevas.
headline: Segunda agencia informa de la subida de 25 puntos basicos

body: Una cadena de supermercados anuncio la apertura de veinte tiendas y la contratacion de 400 personas.
headline: Una cadena de supermercados abre veinte tiendas nuevas

body: Un funcionario que pidio no ser identificado dijo que se vigila el tipo de cambio. La institucion no quiso comentar.
headline: Un funcionario no identificado dice que se vigila el tipo de cambio

body: La oficina de estadistica situo la inflacion armonizada en el 3,1 por ciento anual, frente al 2,8 por ciento previsto.
headline: La inflacion armonizada de la zona euro sube al 3,1 por ciento

body: The flash services activity index fell to 49.8 from 51.2, below the 50 threshold and below the 50.9 expected.
headline: Euro-area services activity index falls to 49.8, below the expansion threshold

body: The flash services activity index printed 49.8. The previous reading was 51.2.
headline: Services index at 49.8 in flash reading

body: The final services activity index confirmed the flash reading of 49.8 with no revision.
headline: Final services index confirms 49.8 with no revision

body: The euro-area central bank corrected a figure in a published balance sheet table, attributing the error to a reporting institution. The policy stance was unaffected.
headline: Euro-area central bank corrects a figure in its published balance sheet table

body: An analyst note argued the euro was undervalued against the dollar on a purchasing power basis and set a twelve-month target.
headline: Analyst note argues the euro is undervalued against the dollar

body: The statistics office postponed the second quarter national accounts release by one week, citing a processing error.
headline: Statistics office postpones the release of second quarter national accounts

body: Euro-area retail sales.
headline: Headline only: euro-area retail sales

body: The two central banks said they would review the terms of an existing standing swap line. The line remains in place unchanged during the review.
headline: Euro-area central bank and northern reserve board announce a standing swap line review

body: A payroll figure republished after a transmission error was unchanged at 310,000. The original release stands.
headline: Payroll figure republished after a transmission error, unchanged at 310,000

body: Sovereign spreads widened after a rating agency announced an unscheduled review of one member state. No rating action was taken.
headline: Euro-area sovereign spreads widen after an unscheduled rating review is announced
